title: Chaplin: The Tramp Who Changed the World
summary: The rise of cinema's first global icon, now streaming on AB Films TV and Fawesome.
overview: An exploration of how Charlie Chaplin went from a poverty-stricken London childhood to creating the Tramp, blending laughter and humanity to shape film as an art form and a voice for social change. It's distributed on streaming channels including AB Films TV and Fawesome.
